title: Red's Experienced
description: A simple but useful mod for players who want a small, convenient way to repair items without relying on XP farms or Shulker Boxes full of XP.
body:
Experienced is a lightweight quality-of-life mod designed for players who want a small, controlled way to obtain XP during work without relying on large XP farms or carrying stacks of experience bottles. The mod focuses on convenience, balance, and practical use rather than automation or replacing vanilla XP Farms.

The mechanics of this mod is very simple: when a you right-clicks while holding a Silence Armor Trim enchanted with Experienced, a single experience orb is spawned. The XP gained is intentionally minimal, making this ideal for item repairs with Mending during long exploration where your Elytra breaks during flight or during combat where your armor durability is low and you want to repair your armor on the spot.

🔹 How It Works

Obtain a Silence Armor Trim.

Enchant the trim with the Experienced enchantment.                                                             
(It is a rare enchanntment. only found in loot tables. not in Enchantment Table or Villagers.)

Hold the enchanted trim in your main hand.

Right-click to spawn one small experience orb.

No new items, blocks, machines, or automated systems are added.

🔹 Practical Use Cases

Experienced is especially useful during combat and PvP situations. When your armor or tools are losing durability and you do not have experience bottles available, this mod allows you to gradually repair gear in real time without leaving the fight. It is also valuable during long exploration sessions where your elytra breaks, boss fights, or controlled repairs where generating large amounts of experience would be unnecessary or unbalanced.

🔹 Design Philosophy

Experienced is designed as a precision tool rather than an experience generator. The amount of XP is intentionly low (2 XP amount to be precise), ensuring that its benefits are earned and it is also not overpowered.

Experienced is ideal for players and servers looking for a clean, minimal enhancement that respects vanilla mechanics.
